source.name: ASTRA Bio wave 1 — Applied Biology
source.license: Original syllabus-based practice questions (exam-frequent themes; not verbatim past papers)

questions.stem: The branch of agriculture concerned with the care and breeding of livestock is
questions.explanation: Animal husbandry covers cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat and related farm animals.

questions.stem: Broiler poultry birds are raised primarily for
questions.explanation: Broilers are meat-type chickens grown rapidly on high-protein feed; layers are kept for eggs.

questions.stem: The Italian honeybee widely stocked in Indian apiaries is
questions.explanation: Apis mellifera is preferred for high honey yield; Apis indica is the Indian hive bee.

questions.stem: The chief food plant of the mulberry silkworm is
questions.explanation: Bombyx mori larvae feed on mulberry leaves before spinning the commercial cocoon.

questions.stem: Stocking Catla, Rohu and Mrigal together in one pond illustrates
questions.explanation: Composite culture uses surface, column and bottom feeders so the whole pond is exploited.

questions.stem: A mule is obtained by
options: interspecific hybridisation of horse and donkey
questions.explanation: The mule is a sterile interspecific hybrid, usually of a male donkey and a female horse.

questions.stem: Superovulation of a donor cow in MOET is induced with
questions.explanation: FSH (or related gonadotrophins) causes several follicles to mature so many embryos can be recovered.

questions.stem: A vaccine prepared from a living but weakened pathogen is described as
questions.explanation: Live attenuated vaccines (for example BCG or Sabin polio) retain immunogenicity with reduced virulence.

questions.stem: Spread of cancer cells from a primary tumour to distant organs is called
questions.explanation: Metastasis is the hallmark of malignancy and involves invasion and colonisation of new sites.

questions.stem: ELISA as used in diagnosis depends on
options: ratios of fish in a pond
questions.explanation: Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay detects antigen or antibody with an enzyme-tagged conjugate.

questions.stem: Layer flocks in poultry farming are maintained mainly for
questions.explanation: Layers are egg-type birds; broilers are the meat-type counterpart.

questions.stem: Mating of unrelated animals of the same breed is called
questions.explanation: Outcrossing brings in unrelated animals of one breed and is used to overcome inbreeding depression.

questions.stem: A cellular proto-oncogene typically becomes a cancer-causing oncogene after
options: complete deletion of the nuclear genome
questions.explanation: Gain-of-function changes convert proto-oncogenes into oncogenes that drive uncontrolled division.

questions.stem: Dairy farm management is aimed chiefly at
questions.explanation: Selection, feeding, housing and veterinary care are organised to raise milk yield and quality.

questions.stem: Which statement about broiler chickens is correct?
options: They are grown for meat and need protein-rich feed
They are kept only for years of egg laying
They are a species of honeybee
questions.explanation: Broilers are meat birds finished in weeks on high-energy, high-protein rations.

questions.stem: Royal jelly and beeswax are commercial products of
questions.explanation: Bee keeping yields honey, wax, royal jelly, pollen and bee venom.

questions.stem: Which statement about Bombyx mori is incorrect?
options: Its larva feeds only on teak leaves
The larva spins a silk cocoon
It is the insect of sericulture
questions.explanation: Bombyx mori is oligophagous on mulberry (Morus), not teak; Tasar moths use other hosts.

questions.stem: In composite fish culture, a surface feeder such as Catla is stocked with
options: column and bottom feeders so all pond zones are used
questions.explanation: Catla (surface), Rohu (column) and Mrigal or common carp (bottom) occupy different feeding niches.

questions.stem: Inbreeding depression in a herd is commonly reversed by
questions.explanation: Mating to an unrelated animal of the same breed restores heterozygosity and vigour.

questions.stem: In MOET, fertilised eggs recovered from the donor cow are
questions.explanation: Embryos at 8–32 cells are flushed and implanted in foster cows so the elite donor can be superovulated again.

questions.stem: Identify the incorrect vaccine pair.
questions.explanation: Tetanus vaccine is a toxoid (inactivated toxin), not a live virus.

questions.stem: A malignant tumour differs from a benign tumour in that it
options: invades nearby tissue and may metastasise
is invariably caused by a virus
questions.explanation: Malignant cells lose contact inhibition, invade and seed secondary growths; benign masses stay localised.

questions.stem: MRI as a diagnostic tool uses
options: strong magnetic fields and radio waves
only ionising X-rays for every scan
only ECG electrodes on the chest
only turbidity readings of a fish pond
questions.explanation: Magnetic resonance imaging aligns nuclear spins in a magnet and reads radiofrequency signals; it is not an X-ray method.

questions.stem: A recommended farm practice for layer hens is
options: adequate calcium in the feed for eggshells
housing them with honeybees in one cage
questions.explanation: Eggshells are calcium carbonate, so layers need extra dietary calcium and a suitable photoperiod.

questions.stem: Mating a superior male of one breed to females of another breed is
questions.explanation: Cross-breeding combines desirable traits of two breeds; Hisardale sheep is a textbook Indian example.

questions.stem: Which statement about cancer is incorrect?
options: Malignant cells may lose contact inhibition
Ionising radiation can act as a carcinogen
questions.explanation: Metastasis defines malignancy; benign tumours do not spread to distant sites.
